name: Morgan T. Okafor
headline: Software Engineer | Distributed Backend Systems | Machine Learning Infrastructure

bullets: Built a document-search service in Python and FastAPI that answers 12,000 analyst queries a week with retrieval over 2M filings and citation links back to source pages
Cut p95 API latency from 840 ms to 210 ms by adding Redis caching, rewriting three hot PostgreSQL queries and batching downstream calls
Shipped a CI pipeline in GitHub Actions that runs 1,400 tests in under 6 minutes, blocks merges on failures and posts coverage diffs on every pull request
Wrote an evaluation harness that scores LLM answers against 300 labeled questions, raising answer accuracy by 18% over two releases
Led the migration of four internal tools from a monolith to separate services with shared authentication and audit logging
Designed a shipment-tracking API in Java that serves 45 carrier integrations and 3M status events a day with idempotent retries and dead-letter handling
Migrated nightly batch jobs to an event pipeline on AWS, reducing data delay from 24 hours to 15 minutes for 1,200 customer accounts
Containerized six services with Docker and documented runbooks that cut on-call pages by 35% within one quarter
Built a rate-limiting layer for partner APIs that held error rates under 0.5% during a 4x holiday traffic spike
Mentored two interns through their first production features, design documents and code reviews
Wrote C++ and Python tooling to replay 900 hours of sensor logs, letting the perception team reproduce field bugs in minutes
Built a Flask dashboard that tracked nightly simulation results across 120 test scenarios and flagged regressions automatically
Reduced simulation setup time from 40 minutes to 7 minutes by caching map tiles and parallelizing scenario loading
Built a TypeScript dashboard for 9,000 students to track course waitlists, replacing a manual email process used by 30 departments
Automated account provisioning with Python and Bash scripts, saving the help desk 20 hours a month
